title: Endpoint ACCESS-BARRIER state persistence/timescale across a window ladder and the validity horizon of a static endpoint denylist
question: On the frozen 57-endpoint credential-free HTTP GET pool (parent EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068, which inherited it verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386; NOT extended because the pre-freeze attainability certificate is satisfied inside the frozen 57), is an endpoint's intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER state STATIONARY across separated observation windows -- measured as the persistence/half-life of each intrinsic class {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT_429, CLEAN, UNAVAILABLE_403, OTHER_NONBARRIER} -- and does a static endpoint-level denylist built from an anchor window at T0 retain predictive validity at T0+delta (false-accept = a denylisted endpoint recovers; false-reject = a previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks), so that the validity horizon and re-probe interval of the product's dead-end policy are ESTIMABLE rather than assumed? The unit of study is endpoint access-state persistence/timescale, NOT next-request barrier classification (that sub-thread is bounded by EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068) and NOT staleness of inherited content (C-FRESHNESS) or Runtime drift controls. The temporal/window axis is measured; the source-vantage axis is a declared single-vantage scope boundary (one stdlib HTTP egress).

hypothesis.H1_stationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is stationary on the tested timescale: the anchor-to-lag barrier persistence is above chance (STATIONARITY_SKILL(1800s) >= 0.05 nats/endpoint with endpoint-permutation p < 0.05 and endpoint-clustered CI lower > 0), the static-denylist false-accept and false-reject rates both stay <= 0.10 through the longest lag, and intrinsic non-rate barriers (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) persist at CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90.
hypothesis.H2_nonstationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is NOT stationary on the tested timescale: at least one denylisted endpoint recovers (false-accept > 0.10 at the first lag) or anchor state carries no information about lag state (STATIONARITY_SKILL not significant), so a pooled static denylist has no usable validity horizon beyond immediate re-observation.
hypothesis.H2b_class_conditional: A static pooled denylist is the wrong object: intrinsic non-rate barriers (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) are persistent (CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90) while rate-driven barriers (RATE_LIMIT_429, observed through the frozen stress stratum) recover within the ladder, so validity is class-conditional and the re-probe interval must differ by class.
hypothesis.H0_null: Memoryless/exchangeable endpoints: the lag state is independent of the anchor state, so STATIONARITY_SKILL is ~0 under the B_EXCHANGE permutation null and a static denylist is no better than a constant usable-endpoint prior.
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1/H2/H2b are orthogonal falsifiable programs on the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate axis 'timescales'. H2 bounds (does not close) an endpoint-level static-denylist prior on this pool/window; no hypothesis advances C-WEB-DYNAMICS above HYPOTHESIS.

falsifier: BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE SATISFIABLE, FROZEN AND REACHABLE (see prereg.md 'Attainability certificate'). Primary quantities: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref=1800s) = plug-in binary mutual information I(B_0 ; B_delta) in nats per endpoint over the ambient barrier indicator, with a B_EXCHANGE endpoint-permutation null (10000 permutations) and an endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI; DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-barrier endpoints that are non-barrier at delta; DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-nonbarrier endpoints that are barrier at delta; DENYLIST_HORIZON = largest ladder delta delta_k such that FA and FR pass at EVERY lag up to and including delta_k (a contiguous valid prefix), else 0. Frozen thresholds: tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.10; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL = 0.05 nats; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_fp_max = 0.05. Let STAT_SIG = (STATIONARITY_SKILL(1800) >= 0.05) AND (perm p < 0.05) AND (clustered CI lower > 0) AND (MI_POWER_OK), where MI_POWER_OK = the frozen PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY generator (rho=1.0 persistent-barrier reference) has power >= 0.80 at the observed T0 ambient barrier prevalence f_b_obs. Let IMMEDIATE_FAIL = (DENYLIST_HORIZON == 0). (S1_STATIONARY) STAT_SIG AND DENYLIST_HORIZON == 1800. (S0_NON_STATIONARY) IMMEDIATE_FAIL OR (MI_POWER_OK AND NOT (STATIONARITY_SKILL >= 0.05 AND perm p < 0.05 AND CI lower > 0)). (SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL) STAT_SIG AND DENYLIST_HORIZON < 1800 AND CLASS_PERSISTENCE[BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE] >= 0.90 AND CLASS_PERSISTENCE[TRANSPORT_ERROR] >= 0.90 AND TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE. (SIN_INCONCLUSIVE) otherwise. Reachability: S1 is reachable because the pre-freeze census observed 5 persistent BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE endpoints (gitlab.com/users/sign_in, community.cloudflare.com, www.npmjs.com/login, wordpress.com/log-in, www.phpbb.com/community/) and 1 persistent TRANSPORT_ERROR endpoint (community.invisioncommunity.com) across a 45s window pair, which yields high STATIONARITY_SKILL and low FA/FR. S0 is reachable because the census observed a live RECOVERY (search.brave.com/search?q=test RATE_LIMIT_429 -> CLEAN across the pair), so at least one denylisted endpoint recovers and FA(beta) > 0.10; and because the pre-freeze onset probe drove CLEAN -> RATE_LIMIT_429 on www.djangoproject.com/admin/login, www.djangoproject.com/accounts/login and auth0.com, showing lag independence (skill -> 0) is attainable for rate-driven strata. SM is reachable because persistent 403s and recovering 429s coexist. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control failure (network, classifier reproducibility, oracle misclassification, PC power < 0.80, NC false-positive > 0.05, or T0 ambient-barrier floor < 3 endpoints), never for a scientific S0/S1/SM.

B_EXCHANGE.description: Mandated memory/constant null: permute the lag-state labels B_delta across endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38074818597), preserving the anchor marginals and each endpoint's cluster, and recompute I(B_0;B_delta). The primary p-value is (1 + #{perm MI >= observed MI}) / (1 + 10000). This is exactly the null that the anchor state carries no information about the lag state beyond the marginal (i.e. the identity-transfer predictor equals the constant-marginal predictor).

B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist baseline: predict non-barrier for every endpoint at every lag. Reference predictor for the secondary DENYLIST_SKILL (log-loss improvement of the anchor-transfer predictor over always-usable).

B_MARGINAL.description: Predict the lag class from the lag-period marginal class frequency (constant marginal predictor).

B_LASTSWEEP.description: Memory/persistence baseline that predicts B_delta_k from the immediately preceding ladder observation B_delta_{k-1} rather than from the anchor B_0. Used only to report whether the most recent observation predicts the next better than the anchor (re-probe interval diagnostic).

baselines.comparison: The primary stationarity metric is measured against the B_EXCHANGE permutation null; DENYLIST_SKILL is measured against B_CONSTANT_USABLE.

PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.description: Offline planted-stationary generator: N=57 endpoints; a fraction f_b are barrier-capable and, conditionally on capability, the lag state equals the anchor state with probability rho (otherwise redrawn from the marginal). The SAME plug-in MI estimator and B_EXCHANGE permutation test are applied. Design-time calibration (non-outcome-bearing, no Web data) used R=200 replications, perms_per_rep=1000, seed 38074818597.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.power_requirement: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be >= 0.80 at the frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80; the achieved design-time power is 1.00. EXECUTE additionally computes MI_POWER_OK = power at the observed f_b_obs under the persistent-barrier reference rho=1.0 (achieved 0.92/0.995/1.00/1.00 at f_b=0.05/0.08/0.10/0.20); STAT_SIG is unavailable when MI_POWER_OK is false.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator recovers a known stationary endpoint population at this sample size; it does not assert that any real endpoint is stationary. Boundary calibration: power=1.00 at f_b=0.10,rho=0.80; power=0.735 at f_b=0.10,rho=0.50 (disclosed; the low-prevalence/low-persistence corner is deliberately NOT claimed as powered).

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status: https://httpbin.org/status/429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; a guaranteed-unresolvable host (https://no-such-host.invalid/) must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR; https://httpbin.org/status/403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving the classifier separates 403-as-plain-unavailability from a challenge 403). The BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE branch is exercised by natural pool endpoints (prerequisite floor >= 1 challenge endpoint at T0) and by the frozen classifier replay control, not by a synthetic oracle.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request is classified into its expected intrinsic class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.construct_boundary: Confirms the live collection+classifier code path can register barriers and can distinguish 403-as-block from 403-as-plain; it is not a natural Web barrier.

NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: N=57 endpoints; anchor and lag binary states are drawn independently with the same per-endpoint Bernoulli prevalence (no persistence). Fed through the SAME estimator and B_EXCHANGE permutation test. Design-time calibration used R=200, perms_per_rep=1000, seed 38074818598.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be <= 0.05; the achieved design-time false-positive rate is 0.01 at p=0.20 (0.03 at p=0.30).
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.construct_boundary: Calibrates the null: a genuinely exchangeable endpoint population must not yield spurious stationarity skill.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control on https://httpbin.org/status/200 and https://httpbin.org/uuid, which must classify CLEAN.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.construct_boundary: Confirms the classifier does not fire on clean responses.

C_PROBE_LOAD.description: Validity control for self-induction, NOT a statistical null: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across the 5 sweep indices for the 52 non-stressed endpoints. Under no probe-induced drift the slope is ~0. A positive slope is reported as a self-induction caveat; it does not by itself invalidate the run but is disclosed next to every persistence estimate.
C_PROBE_LOAD.pass_condition: No hard pass/fail; reported transparently. If the slope CI excludes 0 with rising prevalence it is recorded as a validity threat to the STATIONARY branch.
C_PROBE_LOAD.construct_boundary: Separates genuine endpoint persistence from accumulation of barriers caused by our own single-GET probes.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after), body SHA-256, byte length, first 20000 body bytes for marker matching, elapsed ms, attempt index, sweep index, endpoint and any transport error string. The intrinsic class is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields under the frozen classifier, so AUDIT can recompute it.
measurement_validity.label_determinism: Each sweep's ambient class depends only on that sweep's single response; the load class depends only on that burst's responses. No class depends on the anchor state, so modeling the anchor does not leak the lag label.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: The anchor window is sweep 0; lag labels are sweeps 1..4 at target offsets 20/120/600/1800 s. There is no fitting: the estimator is a pre-registered closed-form mutual information; exactness is by permutation and clustered bootstrap, not cross-validation.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation null (10000 permutations, seed 38074818597) for STATIONARITY_SKILL p-values; endpoint-clustered bootstrap (cluster = registrable domain, 10000 resamples, seed 38074818597) for percentile 95% CIs of STATIONARITY_SKILL and of FA/FR at each lag.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to or dropped. Per-sweep endpoint probe ORDER is a frozen seeded permutation (seed 38074818597) so any residual load effect is not systematically associated with endpoint identity or sweep. No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network egress vantage, one ~30-minute wall-clock window. The source-vantage axis of the mandate is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary. Results describe this pool, this vantage and this window only.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power at the frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 and NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive at p=0.20 must meet their frozen bounds; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications must be correct; the classifier replay must yield 0 mismatches. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Live network must reach the frozen universe and both oracle hosts. At T0 the number of ambient-barrier endpoints must be >= 3 (dynamic-range floor) and the anchor and delta_ref sweeps must both complete; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability failure), because the pre-freeze census shows this floor is achievable.
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Because the stationarity test is powered only when enough endpoints are barrier-capable, MI_POWER_OK = power of the frozen PC generator at the observed f_b_obs under the persistent-barrier reference rho=1.0 must hold for the STATIONARY branch; when it is false and no immediate recovery is observed the result is INCONCLUSIVE (an underpowered negative is not a scientific negative).
measurement_validity.resolution_disclosure: The false-accept resolution is 1/n_denylisted; with the census-consistent n_denylisted ~= 6 the smallest non-zero FA is ~0.17, so tau_FA=0.10 means ANY observed recovery flags the horizon as failed. This coarse but conservative resolution is disclosed; it favors the product-safe NON_STATIONARY reading.
measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is a non-outcome-bearing reachability census (/tmp/opencode/phys380/census.py, 17 fixed endpoints, 2 sweeps separated by 45s, 3 GETs each) plus two non-outcome-bearing design probes (/tmp/opencode/phys380/onset.py for onset reachability; /tmp/opencode/phys380/calib2.py for estimator power/false-positive and branch reachability). These establish attainability, classifier liveness and estimator calibration only; they are not part of the frozen measurement. Their summary is reproduced literally in prereg.md. EXECUTE must itself re-verify all attainability floors from its own collected data (the /tmp artifacts are not a frozen interpretation dependency and may not be re-hashed).

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 20000 bytes of the response body decoded as latin-1 (lossless byte mapping). cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status in {200,202} and body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, or timeout).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error, etc.).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single request's stored fields only; none depends on prior requests, so conditioning on the anchor state is not label leakage.

frozen_universe.source: verbatim endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 (which inherited them verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386); used unchanged. EXECUTE may not substitute, add to, or drop endpoints.

sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY endpoint: a fresh cookie jar, then exactly one HTTP GET to the endpoint URL. Store raw fields; ambient_class = classifier output. Endpoints are probed sequentially in a per-sweep frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38074818597) with inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s.
sweep_protocol.load_probe: Immediately AFTER its ambient probe, each endpoint in stratum_stress additionally receives a burst of B_stress=8 GETs at gap 0.15 s inside a SEPARATE fresh cookie jar; load_class = argmax severity_rank over the 8 responses. The 52 non-stress endpoints receive no load probe.
sweep_protocol.sweep_state_definition: The PRIMARY state used for stationarity/denylist metrics is ambient_class. load_class is used only for the transient-class recovery diagnostic.
sweep_protocol.request_headers: One frozen User-Agent string and Accept header recorded in prereg.md; GET only; no authentication; no credentials; no JavaScript.
sweep_protocol.gap_after_probe: 0.30 s between consecutive endpoints within a sweep.
sweep_protocol.partial_ladder_rule: If a sweep overruns, record the ACTUAL elapsed delta and use it; the analysis maps each sweep to its nearest pre-registered ladder rung. If the anchor (sweep 0) or the delta_ref sweep fails entirely, the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

stratum_stress.definition: Fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable set derived from parent accepted evidence and the pre-freeze census; it is NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent-barrier candidates from parent accepted evidence plus the census; reported as a diagnostic subgroup, NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for STATIONARITY_SKILL and FA/FR; class-conditional persistence uses the T0 ambient class of each endpoint.

decision_rule.metric_definition: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in binary mutual information I(B_anchor ; B_delta), in nats per endpoint, over the ambient barrier indicator (barrier_set vs non-barrier); B_EXCHANGE endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations); endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [LO,HI] (10000 resamples). Higher = more stationary/identity-informative.

primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT: FA(delta) = fraction of endpoints with an ambient barrier at T0 whose ambient class at delta is non-barrier (false-accept: denylisted endpoint recovered).
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT: FR(delta) = fraction of endpoints ambient-non-barrier at T0 whose ambient class at delta is a barrier (false-reject: previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks).
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_HORIZON: largest ladder delta delta_k such that FA(delta_j) <= 0.10 AND FR(delta_j) <= 0.10 for ALL j <= k (a CONTIGUOUS VALID PREFIX from the first lag, so a mid-ladder failure cannot be masked by a later pass); 0 if the first lag already fails.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FIRST_FAIL_LAG: smallest ladder delta at which FA > 0.10 or FR > 0.10, else null when the whole ladder passes.

secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_MULTI: plug-in 6-class mutual information I(C_anchor;C_delta) at delta_ref with the same permutation null.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_SKILL: log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the anchor-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.CLASS_PERSISTENCE: For each intrinsic class, the fraction of endpoints with that T0 ambient class whose delta_ref ambient class is identical.
secondary_quantities.TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE: For stratum_stress endpoints, the smallest ladder delta at which the ambient class is non-barrier after a T0 load_class in barrier_set; report per-endpoint and median.
secondary_quantities.STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of stratum_stress endpoints with T0 load_class in barrier_set that are ambient-non-barrier at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.C_PROBE_LOAD: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across sweeps for the 52 non-stress endpoints (slope, two-sided p).
secondary_quantities.ONSET_n / RECOVERY_n / PERSIST_n: counts of ambient transitions across consecutive ladder sweeps and versus T0.

derived_gates.MI_POWER_OK: power of the frozen PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY generator at (f_b=f_b_obs, rho=1.0, R=200, perms=1000) >= 0.80, using the PERSISTENT-BARRIER reference regime (rho=1.0) motivated by the census's perfectly persistent intrinsic barriers. Achieved power: f_b=0.05 -> 0.92, 0.08 -> 0.995, 0.10 -> 1.00, 0.20 -> 1.00. Power at the lower-persistence reference rho=0.80 is additionally reported (1.00 at f_b>=0.10) to disclose the persistence-sensitivity of the gate.
derived_gates.STAT_SIG_SIGONLY: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND permutation p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0.
derived_gates.TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE: (T0 RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoints are non-barrier at delta_ref in > 0.10 of cases) OR (median TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE < delta_ref) OR (STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.10).

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any measurement_validity prerequisite fails (network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts; classifier replay mismatches > 0; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power at frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 < 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER or NC_CLEAN_ORACLE misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor or delta_ref sweep incomplete).
2. S0_NON_STATIONARY if IMMEDIATE_FAIL OR (MI_POWER_OK AND NOT STAT_SIG_SIGONLY).
4. SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL if STAT_SIG AND DENYLIST_HORIZON < 1800 AND INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE.
5. SIN_INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (notably: NOT MI_POWER_OK without IMMEDIATE_FAIL; or STAT_SIG with a partial horizon that is not class-conditional).
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable to the frozen universe or oracle hosts; classifier not reproducible from stored raw fields; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power < 0.80 at the frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER or NC_CLEAN_ORACLE misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor or delta_ref sweep incomplete. These are attainability/measurement failures and MUST NOT be reported as S0_NON_STATIONARY.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS here; H2/S0 and H2b/SM bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool/window. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion and no EXPERIMENTAL upgrade from this single window ladder.

product_consequence_positive: If S1_STATIONARY: a static endpoint-level denylist built from one observation window remains valid through the longest tested lag (1800 s) on this pool, so the dead-end policy can adopt a long, quantifiable re-probe interval and terminal classification for denylisted endpoints, and does not need an online per-endpoint history model for access decisions. The measured DENYLIST_HORIZON becomes the schedulable re-probe interval.
product_consequence_negative: If S0_NON_STATIONARY or SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL: a pooled static denylist silently goes stale (false-accept = a denylisted endpoint recovers; false-reject = a clean endpoint newly blocks), costing the crawler recoverable targets or wasted retries. The product must either (SM) split the dead-end policy into an intrinsic-block track with a long horizon and a rate-driven track with a short horizon driven by the measured TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE and STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT, or (S0) treat endpoint access state as non-amortizable and re-observe before each use. This bounds (does not close) the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS on this pool/window.

estimated_cost.http_requests_breakdown: 5 sweeps x (57 ambient GETs + 5 stratum_stress x 8 load GETs) = 5 x 97 = 485, plus ~12 oracle GETs; transient retries bounded by the worst-case cap

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the first falsification-first measurement on the frozen credential-free pool of ENDPOINT access-state persistence across separated windows rather than next-request classification, and it produces the two quantities the product's dead-end policy currently assumes: DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT/FALSE_REJECT curves and a DENYLIST_HORIZON, plus class-conditional half-lives. Either branch is decision-relevant (long static horizon vs class-conditional/short horizon) and bounds or advances the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS without repeating the exhausted next-request or value-derivation sub-threads.

director_mandate_trace.requirement_memory_constant_null_calibra: satisfied by B_EXCHANGE permutation null, NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE (FP 0.01 <= 0.05) and PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY (power 1.00 >= 0.80 at f_b=0.20,rho=0.80); see prereg.md 'Null calibration'

scope_boundaries: Credential-free public HTTP GET only; no authentication, JavaScript, DOM, SPA, GraphQL or WebSocket.
One stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network egress vantage and one ~30-minute collection window; the mandate's source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary.
The frozen 57-endpoint universe is used unchanged and is NOT extended; no post-outcome endpoint substitution or dropping.
No LLM calls, no browser, no credentials.
Persistence and denylist validity are tested only through the frozen intrinsic classifier and the frozen ambient/load probes; the horizon is censored at delta_ref=1800 s.
The pre-freeze census/probe artifacts under /tmp/opencode/phys380 are non-confirmatory and are not a frozen interpretation dependency; EXECUTE re-verifies all attainability floors from its own data.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All five dispositions are arithmetically reachable through the frozen metric, and the design-time branch probe on the actual estimator (non-outcome-bearing; /tmp/opencode/phys380/calib2.py) produced them. S1_STATIONARY: a stationary plant (6 persistent barriers / 57) gave STATIONARITY_SKILL=0.3365, permutation p=0.001, FA=0.0, FR=0.0 => STAT_SIG true and HORIZON=1800. S0_NON_STATIONARY: a plant with 3 barriers at T0 all recovered by T1 gave STATIONARITY_SKILL=0.0, p=1.0, FA=1.0 => IMMEDIATE_FAIL. SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL: 6 persistent + 3 recovering endpoints gave STATIONARITY_SKILL=0.236, p=0.001, FA=0.333, FR=0.0 with intrinsic persistence 1.0 => class-conditional. SIN_INCONCLUSIVE is reachable when the ensemble is not significant for identity yet no recovery occurs and MI_POWER_OK is false (low-prevalence corner). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is produced only by prerequisite/control failure, never by a scientific outcome.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: The frozen 57-endpoint universe and both oracle hosts are live-reachable from this environment. The pre-freeze census (17 endpoints, 2 sweeps separated by 45 s, 3 GETs each) observed 5 endpoints with persistent BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE across the pair, 1 endpoint with persistent TRANSPORT_ERROR across the pair, a live RECOVERY (search.brave.com/search?q=test 429 -> CLEAN across the pair), and clean endpoints; a separate non-outcome-bearing probe drove live CLEAN -> RATE_LIMIT_429 onsets on www.djangoproject.com/admin/login, www.djangoproject.com/accounts/login and auth0.com. The live oracles resolved as expected (httpbin 200/403/429; gitlab.com challenge 403; djangoproject admin 200). The classifier is deterministic from stored fields, so reproducibility is checkable. EXECUTE must re-verify network reachability, oracle classifications and the >= 3 T0 ambient-barrier floor before/interpreting collection; failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The primary null is non-degenerate and the metric separates the two regimes rather than sitting at a ceiling. Design-time calibration on the actual plug-in MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation statistic (no Web data) gave: NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive 0.01 at p=0.20 and 0.03 at p=0.30 (<= 0.05), so exchangeable endpoints do NOT produce spurious stationarity skill; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power 1.00 at f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 and 1.00 at f_b=0.10,rho=0.80 (>= 0.80), so a genuinely stationary population is detected. B_CONSTANT_USABLE is a distinct floor from B_EXCHANGE: the identity-transfer predictor can beat the constant-usable prior only when the anchor is informative (MI > 0), and the census shows the anchor is informative (6 persistent barriers, ~10-35% barrier-exposed). rho=0.50 at f_b=0.10 is disclosed as underpowered (0.735), which is why MI_POWER_OK gates the STATIONARY branch.

control_sensitivity.reason: Two disjoint synthetic controls bracket the estimator with demonstrated, not asserted, sensitivity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY requires >= 0.80 power to recover a planted stationary population (achieved 1.00) and NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE requires <= 0.05 false-positive on exchangeable data (achieved 0.01). Two live controls validate the real code path: PC_ORACLE_BARRIER must classify deterministic 429/transport oracles as barriers and httpbin 403 as UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving the 403-discrimination branch), and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE must classify 200/uuid as CLEAN. C_PROBE_LOAD adds a self-induction trend control. Both positive and negative sensitivity are therefore demonstrated synthetically and live.

treatment_liveness.reason: This is a Physics measurement/estimation experiment, not a Product inheritance/residual-novelty/LLM-inheritance/product-economics experiment, so no SPIDER treatment arm exists. The estimable decision object POLICY_STATIC_DENYLIST is a bounded deterministic function of the ambient class (DENY if barrier else ALLOW) with a deterministic re-probe at DENYLIST_HORIZON; it returns a defined decision for every class and always terminates. EXECUTE's first action is a non-network policy trace proving this (recorded in provenance as a measurement prerequisite), so no treatment is structurally incapable of becoming EXECUTABLE.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No pre-existing mutable local code, task bank, dataset or fixture is an interpretation dependency. Every interpretation-determining constant (frozen 57-endpoint universe, literal CHALLENGE_RELITERAL, classifier and severity ranks, sweep ladder, ambient/load probe definitions, strata, thresholds tau/alpha/delta_SKILL/power/FP, seeds, branch logic) is embedded verbatim in spec.json and prereg.md, which the deterministic freezer hashes (freeze.json.hashes.spec.json, prereg.md). The collection/analysis code is authored at EXECUTE strictly as a literal realization of those literals and may not introduce or retune any decision-relevant constant; its hash must be recorded in provenance.json for AUDIT. The /tmp/opencode/phys380 pre-freeze census and probe scripts are non-confirmatory and are explicitly NOT interpretation dependencies (EXECUTE re-derives all attainability floors from its own data), and remote Web responses cannot be frozen. Therefore freeze_artifacts is empty and the binding is NOT_APPLICABLE.
